name: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!
label: Quest
description: During Hallow's End, a young orphan named Jesper lies sick in the Stormwind orphanage, wishing he could join in the holiday festivities. Too ill to go…
intro: During Hallow's End, a young orphan named Jesper lies sick in the Stormwind orphanage, wishing he could join in the holiday festivities. Too ill to go out, he asks Alliance adventurers to go trick-or-treating across the world on his behalf.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick. If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have! I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for! Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well. When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you finished trick-or-treating yet? I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wow, you got them all! You're awesome!
Thank you for trick-or-treating for me. Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
